profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Caterpillar Inc.
profile.summary: Dedicated and skilled Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience across the Software Development Lifecycle. Strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming with expertise in designing, implementing, and testing scalable web applications. Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and relational databases including Oracle and MySQL. Experienced in building modern user interfaces using JavaScript, React, and front-end frameworks, as well as developing backend services with Node.js. Skilled in version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), and Agile/SCRUM methodologies. Seeking opportunities to further expand technical expertise while contributing to the development of innovative, high-quality software solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Spearheaded the modernization of three critical legacy applications into microservices using Java and Spring Boot onto a private cloud, enhancing functionality and sustainability while reducing downtime. 
•	Collaborated in development of two separate microservices to maintain user sessions and simulate experiences for debugging production issues, improving overall system reliability. 
•	Implemented role-based authentication mechanisms using Spring Security to enforce secure access control, ensuring users receive appropriate permissions within the system architecture. 
•	Integrated applications with Oracle databases and implemented scheduling mechanisms to ensure seamless data flow and retrieval. 
•	Pioneered foundational AWS infrastructure initiatives, established a CI/CD pipeline, and utilized Terraform for provisioning, facilitating a transition from legacy systems to the cloud. 
•	Enhanced application performance by implementing caching strategies and optimizing SQL query execution, resulting in significantly reduced load times and improved user experience. 
•	Achieved 80% code coverage through rigorous testing strategies, validating functionality and minimizing defects throughout the software development lifecycle. 
•	Focused on risk metrics and cybersecurity in new role, successfully eliminating the highest V1 and V2 vulnerabilities from legacy applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led 4 tech refresh projects involving front end web servers, backend application servers, Coherence Cache servers, and Oracle Database servers, leveraging deep knowledge on our application’s infrastructure to ensure seamless upgrades and optimizations for all aspects of our project.
•	Proactively handled issue resolution and defect management, swiftly addressing incoming defects and ensuring their resolution to maintain project momentum.
•	Developed and implemented an issue collector system for the team, improving efficiency in tracking and managing reported issues and defects.
•	Maintained comprehensive oversight of risk metrics and cybersecurity vulnerabilities within our codebase, including tracking critical CVEs like CVE-2021-44228 to prioritize and implement necessary security measures and to remediate them within SLA.

positions.title: Customer Service Specialist
positions.description:
•	Resolved issues including returns presented by customers, any delivery/service issues, and issues presented by management to be fixed
•	Boost Best Buy product protection (GSP) with numbers above 25% at Norridge store
•	Trained and helped lead a growing team of Customer Service Specialists to execute any responsibilities required
•	Partnered with Geek Squad to resolve technical issues with devices such as phones and laptops to ensure functionality.

positions.title: Reservations Specialist
positions.description:
•	Informed customers about our company and answered any questions they had about lessons or memberships
•	Efficiently handled all rescheduling matters using software to automatically suggest next best option.
•	Operated the email and phone to provide efficient responses in a timely manner
•	Directed the staff on which classes and assignments they would have for the day

positions.title: Busser/Host
positions.description:
•	Decreased wait time by efficiently cleaning tables to increase turnover, helping more servers get more tables
•	Adapted to roles as needed included busser, host, phone operator, and food runner
•	Coordinated server assignments across 46 tables, up to 9 servers at a time

projects.title: Chicago Crime Database
projects.description: Chicago Crime Database project, where data was pulled from a database of public data of Chicago crimes. Program is made to be able to find the Top 10 Crimes by neighborhood, search for a specific crime and it’s occurrence, and the most occurring crimes per neighborhood. Program was written in C#, with C# serving as the console and SQL used to retrieve the data.

projects.title: Assembly Language Interpretor
projects.description: An assembly language interpretor for a simple assembly language written in C++. The user is prompted for a file with assembly instructions, which is then read and stored into memory. The user can then choose to either execute the file completely, line by line, or to quit the program. Written using inheritance with an abstract superclass and with concrete subclasses for each particular instruction.
